desc:
Wix SEO services for small business set up the parts of your site that search engines read first: titles, headings, URLs, redirects and structured data. Ecom Swift LLC does the work inside your Wix account and reports what changed.

## What are Wix SEO services?

Wix SEO services are hands-on changes that help search engines understand and display your Wix site. They cover page titles and meta descriptions, heading order, clean URLs, image alt text, redirects for old addresses, structured data, Google Search Console and the sitemap. We use the SEO tools already built into your Wix account rather than adding extra plug-ins.

This is technical and on-page setup. It is separate from link building and from writing long articles, though we can plan content with you.

## Why does a small business need SEO setup?

A search engine decides what a page is about from a few clear signals. If your title says "Home" and your heading says "Welcome", nothing tells it you are a dentist in a specific town. Duplicate titles, missing descriptions and messy URLs make pages harder to match to a search.

Local customers often search with a service and a place. Pages that state both in the title, headings and structured data give search engines a clear reason to show you for that search. Without this setup, a good site can stay hard to find.

## How SEO work affects visibility and leads

Better titles and descriptions help in two ways. They help search engines match your page to a query, and they make your result more attractive to read in the listing, so more searchers click. Structured data such as local business details gives search engines facts about your name, address and hours in a form they can read directly.

Redirects protect pages that already have visitors. Search Console shows which pages are indexed and which queries bring people, so you can see what works. Rankings depend on competition, content, reputation and many outside factors, so we cannot promise a position. We make sure the site is not holding itself back.

## What a good Wix SEO setup includes

- A unique, readable title and meta description for each key page.
- One main heading per page, followed by logical subheadings.
- Short, clean URLs that describe the page.
- Descriptive alt text for important images.
- 301 redirects from old addresses to the right new pages.
- Local business schema with name, address, phone and opening hours.
- Social sharing previews so links look right when shared.
- Google Search Console connected and the sitemap submitted.
- The Wix SEO Setup checklist completed.
- Internal links between related pages and a keyword list for main pages.

## What we do

We begin with a review of your pages and the words your customers use. We then set titles, descriptions, headings and URLs in your Wix SEO settings, add alt text and structured data, and fix redirects. We connect Search Console, submit the sitemap and check how pages are indexed.

The Basic package covers core settings for up to five main pages and the Search Console connection. The Standard package extends to more pages and adds local schema, redirects, social previews, a keyword list and the Wix setup checklist. The Premium package covers a much larger site with a keyword map, blog and product templates, speed fixes, internal linking and a content plan. Extra pages and a Google Business Profile check are available as add-ons.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Tell us the services and places you want to be found for.
- Keep your business name, address and phone the same everywhere.
- Publish useful content that answers real customer questions.
- Check Search Console every month or two.
- Update titles when a service or offer changes.

**Avoid:**
- Forcing a single search term into every paragraph until it reads badly.
- Using the same title on several pages.
- Deleting or renaming pages without a redirect.
- Buying cheap links or lists of directory listings.
- Sharing passwords, which we never need.

## Who this service is for

- A local business such as a clinic, trades company or salon that wants to appear for searches in its area.
- A new Wix site owner who has published pages but never set titles or descriptions.
- A business that renamed pages and lost visitors to broken addresses.
- An owner who tried the SEO tools in Wix and wants an expert to finish the job.

## What we need from you

Send your site address, the main services and locations you serve, and the search phrases you already think customers use. Add us as a collaborator or team member in Wix and give Search Console access if you already have it. We never need your password. We report each change in plain language so you can see exactly what was done.
